trial_court: IV Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Judge, Family Court, Vijayawada, F.C.O.P.No.558 of 2020
case_name: Dodda Kaale Mounika vs N I L
facts_of_case: Both petitioners filed F.C.O.P.No.558 of 2020 seeking divorce by mutual consent. They have been living separately since January, 2020.

legal_principles.principle: The court may take up a matter virtually, or if possible physically.
legal_principles.held: As the parties have filed FCOP in the year 2020 seeking divorce by mutual consent and since January, 2020 both of them are living separately, we direct the IV Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Judge, Family Court, Vijayawada, to take up the matter virtually, or if possible physically

outcome.final_order: Direct the IV Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Judge, Family Court, Vijayawada, to take up the matter virtually or physically record the statements of the petitioners and pass orders in accordance with law within a period of two weeks.
